subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Circling back on my earlier email about validated completed applications for {Brand}. One timely read since then: as the UK labour market softens, more candidates chase each role, yet apply rates still sit just above 5 percent year-end and run 4.43 to 7.17 percent by region (Appcast 2026 UK benchmark). A wider pool lifts raw volume but also duplicate and bot noise, which is where our apply-ID dedupe and completed-event postback hold the line. CV-Library leans into deduped apply-throughs for the same reason. Worth comparing against your current cost per clean application?
angle: fresh angle: softening UK labour market widens the applicant pool + thin apply-rate band (Appcast 2026 UK benchmark, just above 5 percent year-end, 4.43-7.17 percent regional)
register_notes: Stage 2 EN jobs_recruitment CPS: acknowledges the second follow-up and references the prior email in the first sentence; FRESH angle anchored to a timely sourced development (UK labour market softening widens the applicant pool) plus the relevant verified apply-rate band (Appcast 2026 UK recruitment marketing benchmark, apply rate just above 5 percent year-end and 4.43-7.17 percent regional, web-verified via cityam and techrseries, carried over from the parent's verified sources); cites one peer from the parent's named set (CV-Library, rotated in for stage 2); no MobUpps figure this stage; market-context numbers real and sourced with URLs in enrichment_sources, no unverified figure introduced; exactly one question mark; {Brand}/RECIPIENT_NAME tokens kept; no sign-off, no em-dash, no curly quotes, no 'X, not Y' comma-negation (stated positively); native business English.
